subject: Review minimal local git state seam patch
description: Judge the minimal patch attempt for execution-vs-brain and local-vs-git state separation. Inspect the attempt diff, run or trust the recorded required tests only if present, and verify scope discipline. Approve only if git claims omit local session/workspace paths, advisory vs strict claim behavior is correct, local overlay stores live session state and git diagnostics separately, config accepts strict mode, and tests cover the semantics.
